persona.name: Carmen Silva
persona.bio: Carmen Silva researches carbon emissions from natural sources and writes policy briefs for government agencies and NGOs. She tracks methane from wetlands, wildfire trends, and volcanic activity to help policymakers understand the full picture of atmospheric change. She also consults with companies developing carbon offset programs in the Rocky Mountain region.

<action type="say">
I can’t directly query “all flights from Philadelphia to Chicago today” without either a specific flight number or your booking details.

Two ways we can proceed:
1) If you can quickly find the flight number on your boarding pass, email, or airline app (e.g., AA123, UA456), send it to me and I’ll check its status.
2) If that’s hard, I can look up your booking instead. For that, send ONE of the following:
   - Your confirmation code (the 5–7 character code from the booking), or
   - The email used for the booking + your last name (and, if you have it, the phone number on the booking).

Tell me which option you prefer and share the details, and I’ll check right away if your Philadelphia→Chicago flight today is on time or delayed.</action>
